channel.title: DR Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from DR Congo, every source cited.

item.title: The Sentry calls for probe into DRC conflict gold
item.description: The Sentry report links DRC gold to Ugandan networks and ADF financing.

item.title: 26 deaths reported in Bunia amid Ebola fears
item.description: Community leaders in Bankoko, Bunia, report over a hundred contacts and 26 deaths in three weeks.

item.title: Kinshasa parents worry over children's sugar intake
item.description: Health professionals warn of dental cavities, overweight, and type 2 diabetes risks from sweets sold near schools.

item.title: DR Congo minister seeks education and energy investment
item.description: Raïssa Malu told a conference in Sicily that electricity access is vital for learning conditions in the DR Congo.
